title: Modern Nashville Townhome | Rooftop Deck Sleeps 12
description:
Welcome to Harmony House #6! Designed specifically for large groups, families, and getaway weekends, this modern 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom townhome offers plenty of space and privacy—featuring 3 bedrooms with private en-suite bathrooms, plus a 4th bedroom with a full dedicated bath nearby.

Other things to note
Relax on the private rooftop deck with city skyline views, gather in the open-concept chef’s kitchen, or head out to explore East Nashville’s top food and nightlife scene.

HIGHLIGHTS & AMENITIES

•	4 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths: Includes 3 private en-suite bathrooms for extra privacy.
•	Rooftop Deck: Expansive city skyline views—ideal for morning coffee or evening nightcaps.
•	Chef's Kitchen: Premium appliances, fully equipped cookware, and an oversized island built for hosting.
•	Free Garage Parking: Attached 2-car garage + access to shared/street parking.
•	Prime Location: Minutes to Lower Broadway, Nissan Stadium, and walking distance to East Nashville local spots.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12)
•	Suite 1: [King Bed] + Private En-Suite Bath
•	Suite 2: [Queen Bunk Bed] + Private En-Suite Bath
•	Suite 3: [Queen Bunk Bed] + Private En-Suite Bath
•	Bedroom 4: [King Bed] + Full Bath Nearby

LOCATION & DISTANCES

•	East Nashville Hotspots: Short walk/drive to Southern Grist Brewery, local coffee shops, cocktail bars, and dining.
•	Nissan Stadium: ~2 miles
•	Lower Broadway & Honky Tonks: ~3 miles
•	Bridgestone Arena: ~3 miles
•	Nashville International Airport (BNA): ~11 miles

GUEST INFORMATION & HOUSE RULES

•	Age Requirement: Primary renter must be 25+ and present for the stay.
•	Check-In: Convenient keyless smart lock entry with custom access codes. High-speed Wi-Fi provided throughout.
•	House Rules: Strict No Pets (pending discussion), No Smoking/Vaping, and No Parties policy. Quiet hours observed 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM.
